objective: Define the canonical intelligence, independent-evidence, signal-fusion, empirical-probability and explainability architecture for NEXUS QUANT without implementing models or selecting vendors.
scope: Define standard EvidencePacket contract for all intelligence families
Define independent technical evidence families and anti-double-counting rules
Define evidence independence/correlation groups and fusion semantics
Define empirical probability/calibration boundary and uncertainty fields
Define LLM role limits and non-authoritative narrative behavior
out_of_scope: Implement indicators, features, strategies, ML models or LLM prompts
Choose final model/LLM vendors or libraries
Enable Demo, Shadow, Live or Auto Trading
tests: Every evidence family emits the same core evidence envelope
Correlated indicators cannot count as independent votes solely by quantity
WAIT and NO_TRADE are first-class outcomes
Probability is empirical/calibrated and not generated by LLM narrative
Reasons for and against a signal are structurally preserved
Risk can consume signal outputs without importing model/provider-specific details
security_tests: Untrusted news/content cannot issue execution commands
LLM outputs are non-authoritative for risk/execution/probability
Source reliability/provenance is mandatory for external evidence
Agent/LLM tools cannot bypass data-quality or risk domains
No secrets or broker credentials are involved
rollback: Revert P02-D architecture artifacts and state/catalog changes. No model/runtime resources are created.
definition_of_done: Task Catalog and Current State are reconciled
